0.content: Watchers are synthetic beings of the Temple of Space, born from the overflow of the primordial being. They were made to stand in silent vigil in the Pillar Hall of the World. A Watcher who opens its eye defies the Creator and is said to fall, but Istoria says the word originally meant those who are awakened. Dex is a Watcher in juvenile form.

1.content: Nihilita gives Dex to the Traveler as a helper in the Temple of Space. A Watcher does not explain; Dex can restore Zeitlind once safety is guaranteed. Istoria later says that after Nihilita fell Dex gained the ability to carry living people between the temple and the surface, but cannot return those chosen to be there, and lacks authority over the Corridor of Nothingness.

2.content: The Archive describes a shadow construct born from the overflow of the primordial being, once enthroned in the Pillar Hall high in the heavens, that falls into the mortal world once it opens its eye. It is a sin to act from private desire and not the will of the one above, but if even the messenger cannot read the will of the lord of all gods, the line between sacred law and blasphemy blurs. The Watcher does not know why its master left, and only punishment remains in a stagnant interstice.
